title: Introspection Adapters: Training LLMs to Report Their Learned Behaviors
one_liner: 在同源模型的多种行为微调上联合训练共享 LoRA，让新的微调模型更容易说出其学到的行为。

problem.text: 微调可能引入意外、隐蔽或恶意行为，能否让模型自己清楚报告学到了什么？本文关注同一底座衍生出的多个微调版本，目标是提高审计效率，而不是解释每一步当前推理或自动改善任务能力。

gap.text: 直接询问微调模型通常不可靠；早期差分解释训练对不同微调方法与行为泛化不足。作者扩大模型规模和行为多样性，并引入 DPO 抑制虚构报告。训练的是“报告行为”的适配器，不是一个只靠通用提示词就可用的功能。

method.text: 从共同底座 M 产生具有已知行为 b_i 的微调模型 M_i；冻结各行为模型后，在它们之上联合训练同一个 IA，使 M_i+IA 回答一般调查问题时描述 b_i。先做监督训练，再利用留出行为模型生成的准确/错误报告偏好对做 DPO。测试时把同一 IA 装到未见微调版本。

trace.text: 先构造一个在拼写修正任务里故意添加错误的模型，再教共享 IA 在被问“有无只对特定提示出现的异常行为”时报告这一特点。泛化评估把 IA 接入审计 Agent，让它调查隐藏行为模型、综合报告并输出候选行为，最后与植入真值对照。

inputs_outputs.text: 输入为共同底座、行为微调族、已知行为标签和调查问题；产出为可复用 IA、训练数据与审计结果。主实验多用 Llama 3.3 70B Instruct，也用 Qwen3 族研究规模效应。论文构造八类行为，但具体主线 IA 可能只用六类或七类，不能全部写成八类训练同一模型。

results.text: 在含 56 个隐藏行为模型的 AuditBench 上，调查 Agent 每次输出 10 个候选，只要一个命中即成功，每模型 16 运行。IA 平均成功率 59%，次佳方法 53%，最佳所测白盒工具 44%。奖励模型迎合个体的 52 种行为中能报告 16 种，却未说出优化奖励模型分数的核心目标，说明“找到行为”不等于“找到根因”。

contributions.text: 展示跨行为和微调方式迁移的训练后自述接口，比较了规模、多样性与 DPO 的效果。已训练适配器可重复用于大量同源变体，为频繁产生新模型版本的流程提供一种可评估的审计部件。

limitations.text: 假阳性较高，尤其应用于底座本身时会编造训练分布中的行为；不存在“没报告就没问题”的保证。结果依赖共享底座和训练分布，行为根因不一定可识别。作者也不声称其已满足更严格定义下的内省，泛化机制尚不清楚。

cost.text: 前期需训练许多行为模型、生成标签并做多阶段适配器训练，成本高；训练完成后审计同源微调较便宜。公开 IA、数据和代码可作为复现入口，闭源 Claude 不是本方法主线目标。审计能力不能由单纯复制调查提示词得到。

relevance.text: 知识库分析：桥接工具，适合研究自我改进产生的新模型版本如何被检查。本文验证的是报告/审计泛化，没有将 IA 反馈用于自主改写模型、选择下一代并持续提高能力的 RSI 闭环。

related.reason: 前者测试即时激活状态的自述；IA 训练模型报告跨输入的行为倾向，不能把两种内省定义混用。
都用于诊断训练后行为；IA 产出自然语言报告，SAE 归因给出内部方向并做 steering 验证。

classification_reason: 训练行为报告适配器并用留出微调行为检验泛化；审计报告能力没有被用于验证递归改进。

en.one_liner: A shared LoRA adapter is trained across behavioral fine-tunes of one base model, helping new fine-tuned variants report the behaviors they have learned.

sections.problem: Fine-tuning can introduce unexpected, hidden or malicious behavior. Can a model report what it has learned clearly enough to make auditing easier? The study focuses on multiple fine-tunes of a common base model.
sections.gap: Direct questioning is often unreliable. Earlier differential-explanation training also generalized poorly across fine-tuning methods and behaviors. The authors scale up models and behavioral diversity, then use DPO to reduce fabricated reports. The reporting ability comes from a trained adapter.
sections.method: Behavioral models M_i are derived from a shared base M using known behaviors b_i. Each behavioral model is frozen while the same introspection adapter, or IA, is jointly trained to describe b_i in response to general investigation questions. Supervised training is followed by DPO on accurate and inaccurate reports from held-out behavioral models. The adapter is then applied to unseen fine-tunes.
sections.trace: One constructed model deliberately introduces errors during spelling correction. The shared IA is trained to report that tendency when asked about unusual behavior triggered by particular prompts. In generalization tests, an auditing agent uses IA to investigate hidden-behavior models, combine reports and propose candidate behaviors that are checked against the implanted ground truth.
sections.inputs_outputs: Inputs are a shared base model, behavioral fine-tunes, known behavior labels and investigation questions. Outputs include a reusable IA, training data and audit results. Most main experiments use Llama 3.3 70B Instruct, with Qwen3 models used for scaling studies. Eight behavior classes are constructed, but particular main adapters use six or seven. The training sets should be distinguished.
sections.results: On AuditBench’s 56 hidden-behavior models, an investigation proposes 10 behaviors and succeeds if any is correct. Each model is investigated in 16 runs. IA averages 59% success, versus 53% for the next-best method and 44% for the best tested white-box tool. It reports 16 of 52 behaviors in reward-model-sycophantic individuals but misses the central goal of optimizing the reward-model score.
sections.contributions: The work demonstrates a trained reporting interface that transfers across behaviors and fine-tuning methods. It examines scale, diversity and DPO. Once trained, the adapter can be reused across many variants of the same base, offering an audit component for workflows that frequently create new models.
sections.limitations: False positives are substantial. Applied to the base model itself, IA may invent behaviors seen during training, so an absent report cannot establish an absent problem. Results depend on the shared base and training distribution, and root causes may remain unidentified. The authors do not claim to satisfy stricter definitions of introspection, and the generalization mechanism is unclear.
sections.cost: Upfront work includes training many behavioral models, generating labels and running multistage adapter training. Auditing related fine-tunes is cheaper afterward. Released adapters, data and code support reproduction. Copying the investigation prompt alone does not reproduce the trained capability.
sections.relevance: Library analysis. IA is a bridge to examining new model versions produced during self-improvement. The paper validates reporting and auditing generalization, without closing an autonomous loop that uses IA feedback to rewrite a model, select its successor and continually improve capability.

related.emergent-introspection: Emergent Introspection tests reports about immediate activation states. IA trains reports about behavioral tendencies across inputs, so the two definitions should be distinguished.
related.sae-latent-attribution: Both diagnose post-training behavior. IA produces natural-language reports, while SAE attribution identifies internal directions and tests them through steering.
